hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: A_G0001 = F(p,q) for p != q; A_G0002 = lim_{q -> p} F(p,q), expressed by the raw piecewise as ds(p).
required_assumptions: The limit lim_{q -> p} (s(p) - s(q))/(p - q) exists and equals ds(p).
p and q are independent scalar symbols.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The source expression is a piecewise with a generic branch for p != q and a degenerate branch for p == q. The two catalog members are the two branches, linked by the confluent limit of the divided difference.

hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: A_G0001 = F[p,q] = (s(p) - s(q))/(p - q); A_G0002 = F[p,p] = ds(p), the Hermite divided difference with coalesced node p.
required_assumptions: F is differentiable at p so that the confluent divided difference is well-defined.
ds(p) denotes the first derivative of s at p.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: In divided-difference algebra, a derivative is the confluent case of a first divided difference when two nodes coincide. The catalog pair exactly corresponds to the generic and confluent branches of the Hermite construction applied to s.
